summary: Verified WebAdminDashboard cockpit fixes at 1024/1280/1440 desktop viewports. All 7 module tabs (Home, Submissions, Dealers, Billing, Rewards, Kredo, Advertising) + Export CSV + Logout buttons are fully visible (no clipping) at every tested width — topbar wraps onto a second row via flexWrap (topbarLeft row + topbarRight row). New Home landing view is now the DEFAULT view on load: renders 'Admin Cockpit' title/subtitle, three stat cards (INCOMING/PRICED/ARCHIVED with real counts 0/17/3), and six tinted tiles (Submissions, Dealers, Billing, Rewards, Kredo, Advertising) each wired as TouchableOpacity to setView. Tapping the Submissions tile correctly switches to the Submissions module (admin-search-input visible). Tapping the Home topbar button returns to the tile grid. Sequentially clicking each module tab (dealers, billing, rewards, kredo, ads, submissions) switches views without error. Screenshots captured for 1024/1280/1440 all showing complete UI.

issues: Even at 1440x900 the topbar wraps onto 2 rows (module tabs on row 1, Export CSV + Logout on row 2). Per the fix, wrapping was intentionally allowed from 1024-1279; at 1280/1440 the user may have expected a single row. All controls remain fully visible so this is a mild UX observation, not a functional bug. If a single-row layout at >=1280 is desired, reduce logo width further or drop topbarLeft padding.

react_native_issues.component: Deprecated style props (project-wide, not this PR)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use 'textShadow'), 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use 'boxShadow'), Image style.resizeMode deprecated (use props.resizeMode), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Pre-existing; not introduced by this change but visible in cockpit render.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If a single-row topbar at >=1280 is desired, shrink logo further or reduce topbarLeft padding — currently topbar wraps to 2 rows at all tested widths (1024/1280/1440). Not blocking; all controls visible.
OPTIONAL (project-wide, non-blocking): Address pre-existing React Native web deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, Image.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: WebAdminDashboard.tsx is 2775 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the Home landing view, topbar, submissions detail pane, cover pane, and module screens into separate files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin (admin@fourbuy.co.za / admin123) and existing submission data (17 priced, 3 archived).
